Blue-colored [[Bokoblin]]s appear in {{TWW}} and {{TP}}, but they are unnamed and known as their default color variants. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Blue Bokoblin|Blue Bokoblins|Series, SS, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{SS}} * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{SSHD}} }} ==Characteristics== ==={{SS|-}}=== {{Stub|SS}} {{Descriptions SS}} In {{SS}}, Blue Bokoblins are much stronger than a [[Red Bokoblin]]. Their skin and clothing differs depending on the different environments, but they still have the same fixation with exotic undergarments. Blue Bokoblins wear chainmail vest and shorts, also adorning a bandana similar to [[Red Bokoblin (Leader)|Red Bokoblins (Leader)]] and gold ringers on their fingers. The Blue Bokoblin swords are black scimitars contrasting the Machetes used by Red Bokoblins and the hammers used by [[Green Bokoblin]]s. They fight the same way as their weaker variants, but can also do a Jump Attack. During the [[Horde Battle]], the Blue Bokoblin found near the final entrance can do a charging attack similar to [[Ghirahim]] in his first fight. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Blue Bokoblin}} In {{BotW}}, Blue Bokoblins are stronger a stronger variation of [[Bokoblin]]s, as they have more health and wield stronger [[Bokoblin Gear]] and [[Weapon]]s. They are more clever than regular Bokoblins, knowing to kick away [[Remote Bomb]]s to avoid an explosion. In [[Master Mode]], they are the first type of Bokoblin encountered in {{BotW|-}}. During the [[Recovered Memory]] "[[A Premonition]]", one Blue Bokoblin can be seen amongst the [[Monster]]s that have been defeated by [[Link]]. As part of the "[[Missing in Action]]" [[Side Quest]], Blue Bokoblins can be found attacking [[Canolo]], [[Flaxel]], [[Oliff]], and [[Palme]] on the [[Koukot Plateau Path]]. When Link defeats the Blue Bokoblins, the will leave for [[Gerudo Canyon Stable]] to meet with [[Sesami]]. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Blue Bokoblin (normal) |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Bokoblin Guts | 1 | 40 % |- | Bokoblin Fang | 1-2 | 80 % |- | Bokoblin Horn | 1 | 100 % }} |- | FireArrow | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Fire Arrow x5 | 1-2 | 30 % |- | Bokoblin Fang | 1-2 | 70 % |- | Bokoblin Horn | 1 | 100 % |- | Bokoblin Guts | 1

They resemble their {{BotW}} counterparts, but with longer, forked [[Blue Bokoblin Horn|Horns]]. Some Blue Bokoblins wear [[Rock Armor]], which protects them from damage. This Rock Armor displays a yellow health bar and can be broken with blunt [[Weapon]]s and explosions. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} In {{AoC}}, Blue Bokoblins appear as an upgrade to Bokoblins and just like their weaker counterparts, can act as standard troops and large [[Powerful Foe]]s. Both types of Blue Bokoblin can toss their [[Weapon]]s at the [[Warrior]]s and then immediately take out a duplicate Weapon after finishing their ranged attack. When defeated, Blue Bokoblins may drop [[Bokoblin Fang]]s, [[Bokoblin Guts|Guts]], or [[Bokoblin Horn|Horns]].
